name: Crispy Golden Tater Tots Side
whyItWorks: Tater tots are grated potatoes deep-fried in hot commercial shortening. The high surface-area-to-mass ratio absorbs substantial fat, and the crispy fried exterior can irritate inflamed gut mucosa and accelerate intestinal motility.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Flare Warning: Limit to 3-4 pieces if in remission, or substitute a plain soft roll or white bun to avoid heavy frying grease.
